title.en: BATHYMETRIC & HYDROGRAPHIC SURVEY SERVICES IN KENYA
title.sw: HUDUMA ZA UCHUNGUZI WA BATHYMETRIC & HYDROGRAPHIC NCHINI KENYA

description.en:
Advanced Underwater Mapping for Dams, Rivers, Lakes & Coastal Engineering in Kenya and beyond.

We offer high-precision bathymetric and hydrographic surveys using sonar-based depth measurement systems integrated with GNSS RTK positioning to map underwater terrain for engineering, environmental, and infrastructure projects across Kenya and East Africa.

From dams to rivers and reservoirs — we map what lies beneath the surface.
description.sw:
Uchoraji Ramani wa Chini ya Maji wa Hali ya Juu kwa Mabwawa, Mito, Maziwa & Uhandisi wa Pwani nchini Kenya na zaidi.

Tunatoa uchunguzi wa bathymetric na hydrographic wa usahihi wa juu kwa kutumia mifumo ya kipimo cha kina cha sonar vilivyojumuishwa na uwekezaji wa GNSS RTK kuchaoraji ramani ardhi ya chini ya maji kwa miradi ya uhandisi, mazingira, na miundombinu kote Kenya na Afrika Mashariki.

Kutoka mabwawa hadi mito na mifereji — tunachora ramani yale yaliyopo chini ya uso.

description.en: Bathymetric surveys involve measuring the depth of water bodies and charting the underwater terrain. This technique is crucial for understanding sediment levels, water volume, and underwater hazards. It supports safer construction, better water resource management, and proactive environmental protection. SmartGrid Surveying uses high-resolution echo sounders, GNSS positioning systems, and remote-controlled survey boats to access shallow and restricted water zones safely and efficiently.
description.sw: Uchunguzi wa bathymetric unahusisha kupima kina cha maji na kuchora ardhi ya chini ya maji. Mbinu hii ni muhimu kwa kuelewa viwango vya mashapo, kiasi cha maji, na hatari za chini ya maji. Inasaidia ujenzi salama, usimamizi bora wa rasilimali za maji, na ulinzi wa mazingira makini. SmartGrid Surveying hutumia echo sounders za mwonekano wa juu, mifumo ya uwekaji ya GNSS, na boti za uchunguzi zinazodhibitiwa kwa mbali kufikia maeneo ya maji ya kina kifupi na yaliyozuiliwa kwa usalama na ufanisi.
